findings.resolution: The replay policy derives all graph nodes as candidate seeds and all reachable material-target paths; callers cannot submit a smaller path, target or edge scope or make empty scope appear complete.
Every edge in the exact structural path union must pass current R0.1 replay under independently pinned propagation, path, trusted-edge and extractor-registry policy identities.
Evaluation time is sampled privately from current UTC; stale historical artifacts fail and still-valid historical artifacts are refreshed only after current replay and static provenance equality.
Historical refresh compares every non-time-derived root, scope and hop field, preventing tamper from being hidden by a new evaluation timestamp.
All complete-path results remain ANALYSIS_ONLY and release_eligible=false; failures create typed RELEASE_ONLY gaps and do not remove or weaken legacy analysis.
Direct rename, diamond, cycle and input-permutation tests prove deterministic unique simple paths without scenario-specific identifiers.
Changed-seed attestation, upstream source capture, durable anchoring and R0.3-R0.5 release inputs remain explicit blockers and prevent promotion beyond FOUNDATION.
